latest.title: Big Copilot in your language
latest.summary: The footer's Game names setting is now Language, and it translates the whole page: Big Copilot comes in German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Russian as well as English, with the game's names to match. The game's other languages still change the game's names, and the rest of the page stays English. Your choice is kept for your next visit. Most of the Spanish, French, Portuguese and Russian is machine-translated for now; if you speak one of them, the link under the picker shows how to help check it.
